The fix is PR #3793, "(fix) O3-6097: Fix inverted labels on the free text dosage toggle", merged on 2026-10-12 as commit `1c19126f11ca5bb93891bd18d89910d20f41ee84`. The bug was in the `labelA`/`labelB` props passed to Carbon's `Toggle`. Carbon shows `labelA` when the toggle is unchecked and `labelB` when it is checked, and the code had them reversed. The fix swaps them so `Off` is `labelA` and `On` is `labelB`. The PR also adds a test that checks the label text in both states. The PR's branch commit is `1a22cd158049dc27d32cce2c37cf39575099e208`, and the merge commit is the one on the default branch.

The lines that implement the fix are in `drug-order-form.component.tsx`, in the `ControlledFieldInput` toggle branch (lines 981–982 in the current file). The regression test is in `drug-order-form.test.tsx` (lines 324–339 in the current file).
